thread:
maya: heads up — i'm opening a PR to deprecate the old tracehook SDK snippet in the console docs. keeping the migration path but replacing the quickstart sample with the new `trace.attach()` API. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412 :wave:

jonathan: saw the PR, thanks. can you paste the new snippet here? want to sanity-check the embed fallthrough behavior.

maya: sure — short version: old snippet called `initTrace()` which auto-fallbacked to the legacy tracer. new API is explicit:

```
from redwood import trace

# new explicit attach
tracer = trace.attach(api_key=os.environ['REDWOOD_KEY'], service='my-service')
with tracer.span('external_call'):
    call_model(...)
```

it keeps a small compat shim so apps using `initTrace()` will still work, but we strongly recommend switching.

sasha: two quick asks: 1) update the console embed example to show `trace.attach()` inside a background worker (we had confusion during the migration). 2) add a note about cost/latency tag propagation for the dashboard — users need to set `service` and `env` tags for the cost breakdown to group correctly.

maya: good call. i'll add the worker example and the cost-tag note.

docs-bot: PR opened by @maya in docs repo: "deprecate tracehook quickstart, add trace.attach() sample and backcompat shim" — CI queued.

alex: small UX nit: the old snippet used inline `REDWOOD_KEY` env var in examples. we should switch to `export REDWOOD_KEY` / secrets wording so people don't paste keys into demos. also pinging platform team about rollout plan for the shim so we can remove it in 6 months.

maya: updated the PR with `export REDWOOD_KEY` wording and added a migration section labeled "compat shim (temporary)" with a date for removal. also added a tiny back-compat shim example for JS and Python.

sasha: QA checklist proposal: 
- docs: change snippet in console/getting-started (done in PR)
- links: add redirect from /docs/tracehook-quickstart -> /docs/trace-attach-migration
- samples: update embedded dashboard tutorial to include `service`/`env` tags
- SDK: coord with eng-runtime to ensure shim logs a deprecation warning only once per process

jonathan: add me as reviewer on the PR. i'll run a quick smoke test with the sample app and the dashboard cost breakdown. if the `service` tag shows correctly we can merge with docs-only label.

maya: thanks — assigning you now. merging plan: hold for 24h for any objections, then merge behind docs-only label, followed by a patch to the samples repo to update the embed.

alex: one more: can we include a minimal code diff in the PR description so reviewers don't have to hunt through the files? small snippet plus the deprecation timeline will help.

maya: done — PR description now contains the before/after snippet and the 2026-09-01 deprecation removal date. :white_check_mark:

jonathan: great, i'll test the dashboard grouping tonight and report back. if anything breaks we can flip a quick revert flag in the console.

maya: perfect. thanks all, i'll post the final merge link here once CI passes. :pray:
